cmp_jory->pc_main.subject: cmp_jory
cmp_jory->pc_main.opinion: Best thing about this village, and I'd say it to anyone.

npc_cotter->pc_main.subject: npc_cotter
npc_cotter->pc_main.opinion: Steadier than I was at that age. Not by much.

npc_nell->pc_main.subject: npc_nell
npc_nell->pc_main.opinion: Comes in for bread they don't need. I let them.

npc_tam->pc_main.subject: npc_tam
npc_tam->pc_main.opinion: One of us. Always has been.

npc_ilsa->pc_main.subject: npc_ilsa
npc_ilsa->pc_main.opinion: Cotter's. Which means something, whether they know it or not.

npc_hob->pc_main.subject: npc_hob
npc_hob->pc_main.opinion: Pays for what they take. More than most.

npc_halla->pc_main.subject: npc_halla
npc_halla->pc_main.opinion: Mine. Getting too old to tell.

npc_dunn->pc_main.subject: npc_dunn
npc_dunn->pc_main.opinion: Good hands. Better than mine were.

npc_bryn->pc_main.subject: npc_bryn
npc_bryn->pc_main.opinion: Annoying. Would kill for them. Both true.

npc_cotter->npc_ilsa.subject: npc_cotter
npc_cotter->npc_ilsa.opinion: She decided, and I went along with it, and I have not slept properly since.

npc_ilsa->npc_cotter.subject: npc_ilsa
npc_ilsa->npc_cotter.opinion: He kept it. Eleven years, and he kept it.

npc_cotter->npc_vosk.subject: npc_cotter
npc_cotter->npc_vosk.opinion: I have met his sort before. They always pay, and it is never the price.
